speaker: Doctor
text: GREETING: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing double vision, difficulty climbing stairs, and weakness in your arms. To begin our assessment, have you noticed if your double vision improves when you close one of your eyes?

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis. The combination of ocular symptoms worsening with downward gaze and generalized muscle weakness that fluctuates with activity (fatigability) is classic for Myasthenia Gravis. Please proceed with testing to confirm: REQUEST TEST: Acetylcholine_Receptor_Antibody, REQUEST TEST: Repetitive_Nerve_Stimulation, REQUEST IMAGES: Neck_MRI.
